description: Release governance rules for professional services deployments.

policies.rule: No workflow changes to ACTIVE workflows without RGS pre-flight check.
OIS must not decline more than 5 points within any 7-day window without a CHECKPOINT snapshot saved.
CRITICAL risks created by WAANDA agents must be acknowledged within 24 hours.
L3 approval queue must not accumulate more than 10 pending items — flag to admin if exceeded.
Enterprise DNA must be recomputed at least once every 30 days.
COIG baseline must be set before any COIG numbers are communicated externally.
